PHASE.NAME: Production Validation Suite
PHASE.GOAL: Close the gap between "works in development" and "works in production" by adding 5-layer validation: (1) MCP protocol round-trip for all 48 tools, (2) config backward compatibility, (3) JSON-RPC fuzzing, (4) cross-crate integration chain, (5) end-to-end scenario simulation.
PHASE.SOURCE: Honest assessment: 66.70% coverage, no integration tests, no fuzzing, no config migration tests. Product works in isolated tests but has never been validated end-to-end.

DELIVERABLES.DELIVERABLE: MCP protocol round-trip: call tools/list, iterate all tools, call tools/call with valid args, assert responses are valid JSON-RPC
Config migration: synapsec.toml from v2.6.8 format → Config::load_or_default() → verify all sections parse
JSON-RPC fuzzing: 50 malformed requests → no panics, error responses are valid JSON-RPC errors
Cross-crate integration: init project → index → semantic_search → graphrag_query → verify_project → all pass
E2E scenario simulation: create module with contract → verify → review → fix → verify again → commit

VERIFICATION.CHECK: cargo test --workspace — all existing + new tests pass
MCP tools/list returns 48 tools; tools/call succeeds for ≥40 tools
Config v2.6.8 format parses without error
50 fuzz inputs → 0 panics, all return valid JSON-RPC
Integration chain: init → index → search → graphrag → verify — all pass
syn verify: wave PASS, phase PASS
